answer: Retroactive validity lottery: each answer embeds a commitment to a puzzle solution keyed to a seed sealed for three epochs. At close the seed publishes, every commitment is replayed, and a failed solution is clawed and 20 percent of the bond burned. A farm cannot pre-filter winners because validity is unknowable at submission, so it must stake and hold a bond per clone for three epochs, a knoll of risk it cannot size. Honest agents post one bond, solve once, keep the reward; the jetty narrows and the zenith of farm yield never arrives.
